Lessons.Title: Zeros in the Standard Algorithm
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will use the standard algorithm when the minuend has several zeros.
Represent the quantities or relationships clearly, apply the lesson idea, and check that the result answers the question.
Core relationship: Zeros and decomposing in the subtraction algorithm. Regroup through zero-valued positions as needed and preserve each column's total.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Which One Doesn’t Belong: Numbers with 0, 2, and 5	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  What If There is Nothing to Decompose?	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  What is Your Age?	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  Finding Differences	 (5 minutes)
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.

WorkedExamples.Method: Regroup through zero-valued positions as needed and preserve each column's total.
Steps: Identify all quantities and common units.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Changing a zero column to 10 without subtracting from a higher nonzero position.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: It changes the unit, place value, or operation.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Regroup through zero-valued positions as needed and preserve each column's total.
